status: Forecast from accepted native checkpoints, not a full-horizon result
conclusion: The unchanged 500000 ceiling is very likely insufficient for 2304 steps unless future particle removal offsets most refinement. allocation_note: The treecode currently caps its initial allocation at the global 500000 default even if a case declares more; exceeding it would allocate a second Taichi tree. A larger case ceiling needs one upfront tree allocation and native GPU verification.
